title: •Mara Jade, The Emperor’s Hand
caption: •Mara Jade, The Emperor’s Hand (V)
game_text: While Luke or Emperor on table, power +1 and she moves for free. Permanent weapon is •Mara Jade’s Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).
lore: *Spy*. Ordered to kill Luke Skywalker. Assumed the identity of a dancer named ‘Arica’ in order to sneak into Jabba’s palace.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1999 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip's heading/caption (Emperor’s) and in •Mara Jade’s; wiki titles straight. Stats POWER 4 / ABILITY 5 / FORCE-SENSITIVE (label only); deploy 6 / forfeit 7 — the stub's 'deploy=7' is the forfeit (stub error). Icon column top to bottom: blue warrior (blaster) → warrior, black square with green lightsaber → permanent-weapon (the printed card's Pilot icon is gone). Two discs top-left on the printed card: Alien (black, glowing eyes) + Imperial (wiki subtype Alien/Imperial). Two-line margin credits: left 'Original concept / by Justin Rath', right 'New York / State 2005'. Lore corrected from scan: 'Spy' bold (period not bold) as printed; curly ‘Arica’ and Jabba’s (wiki straight). Base scan only 350 px (low-res: bold and quote shapes read at 350 px); EJP copyright as the run's convention (SE-style, 1999), not legible. No modern remake of this card found (V0-/VB4-D-marajadewithlightsaber are a different card).
